accessRules.label: Qantas Club on Qantas
conditions: Requires an eligible annual or multi-year Qantas Club membership. Qantas Club Flexible membership does not include the Los Angeles lounges.
accessRules.note: Present an eligible active Qantas Club membership and same-day onward Qantas boarding pass. Other Qantas Club partner routes are outside this initial rule coverage.

accessRules.label: Alaska Lounge+ on an eligible international flight
conditions: Requires a qualifying purchased or award international flight and current digital Alaska Lounge+ membership.

accessRules.label: Other qualifying oneworld premium itinerary
conditions: Confirm a qualifying international premium itinerary or eligible same-day long-haul connection. A short domestic US First or Business ticket alone does not grant access.

lounges.name: Alaska Lounge

accessRules.label: Qantas Gold, Platinum or Platinum One on oneworld
accessRules.note: Domestic itineraries can qualify with Qantas status. Add your qualifying frequent-flyer number to the booking before check-in.

accessRules.label: oneworld Sapphire or Emerald
conditions: Confirm the status issuer and route: American and Alaska/Hawaiian Atmos status has North American itinerary exclusions.
accessRules.note: Your qualifying frequent-flyer number must be in the booking before check-in.

accessRules.label: Alaska Lounge+ on oneworld
accessRules.note: Present your current membership and same-day qualifying boarding pass. Additional Alaska global partners are outside this initial rule coverage.

accessRules.label: Admirals Club reciprocal access
conditions: Requires an eligible full Admirals Club membership; single-use memberships and authorized-user credit-card benefits do not qualify for partner access.

accessRules.label: Qualifying Alaska or Hawaiian First ticket
conditions: Requires a qualifying paid or award First ticket, with an Alaska/Hawaiian-operated flight of at least 2,000 miles that day. Upgrades do not automatically qualify.

lounges.note: Priority Pass access at SFO does not establish access here. Current LAX Priority Pass coverage is represented separately by the Virgin Atlantic Clubhouse. Shower, spa and restaurant availability are not verified.

lounges.name: Virgin Atlantic Clubhouse
lounges.location: Airside, Level 6; take the lift near the clock tower in the main atrium.

hours.note: These are the published Priority Pass access hours.

accessRules.label: Priority Pass · additional US$35
accessRules.note: Mandatory US$35 per person in addition to your normal membership visit or guest fee. Maximum visit 3 hours. Capacity restrictions may limit entry, especially 12:00–22:30. Complimentary showers are first come, first served.

sources.title: Priority Pass: Virgin Atlantic Clubhouse LAX and supplement

lounges.note: The Priority Pass listing confirms an à-la-carte menu, complimentary showers and an in-lounge cinema. Airline premium-ticket and status access are outside this initial rule coverage.

lounges.name: Star Alliance Lounge
lounges.location: Airside, Level 6, above the Great Hall.

hours.note: Current opening hours were not confirmed from the official sources reviewed. Check the operating airline before making a terminal detour.

accessRules.label: Star Alliance Gold on Star Alliance
conditions: Confirm the status-issuing program and entitlement with the operating airline, especially for a domestic United itinerary. United Club access rules are separate from this alliance lounge's rules.
accessRules.note: Present your qualifying membership and departing Star Alliance boarding pass. Guest rules depend on the operating airline and same-flight requirements.

accessRules.label: United Premier Gold, Platinum or 1K on an international Star Alliance flight
accessRules.note: Applies to this Star Alliance lounge, not United Club or Polaris lounges. Present your current Star Alliance Gold status and same-day departing Star Alliance boarding pass.

ANA Premium Economy
accessRules.note: ANA publishes a specific Premium Economy access entitlement for ANA-operated flights; it does not extend to other airlines' Premium Economy cabins.
